# FronteraEval

> A source-linked, evolving catalogue of frontier AI evaluations, designed to clarify what each evaluation can and cannot establish.

- Website: https://fronteraeval.org/
- Indexable catalogue: https://fronteraeval.org/evaluations/
- Topics: https://fronteraeval.org/topics/
- Method: https://fronteraeval.org/method/
- About and epistemic limits: https://fronteraeval.org/about/
- JSON data: https://fronteraeval.org/data/catalog.json
- Source code: https://github.com/apolmig/fronteraeval

The catalogue contains 314 records and 30 documentary methodological reviews. Documentary review is not independent experimental replication.
